title: Everything You Know About the Salem Witches Is Wrong
description:
Not one witch was burned in Salem in 1692. So what really happened to the 20 people who died?

The legend says Salem burned its witches. The court records say otherwise: 19 hanged, one man crushed under stones, and the last name cleared in 2022. Real or myth? Tell me in the comments.
Subscribe to Or So The Story Goes for more history myths, told from the sources.

Sources: Tituba's examination (1 March 1692); Salem court records; Samuel Sewall's apology (14 January 1697); Massachusetts exoneration of Elizabeth Johnson Jr. (2022).
Art: public-domain works by Goya, Salvator Rosa, J. W. Waterhouse, T. H. Matteson, J. E. Baker; Upham's map of Salem Village; Gardiner's woodcut (1655), via Wikimedia Commons.
Music: original score generated with vidIQ. Narration: vidIQ voiceover.
